HomePage.title: Home
HomePage.description: The university student platform for sharing resources and books.
HomePage.heroTitle: Your Companion in the University Journey
HomePage.heroSubtitle: Everything you need from summaries, past exams, and university books in one place. A complete student community to help you excel.

Requests.title: Ask for it. Let a fellow student help.
Requests.subtitle: Need a book, slides, a past exam, or anything else for university? Post your request and hear from students who can help.
Requests.newEyebrow: Two steps to share your need
Requests.newSubtitle: Make your request clear and select the course when possible. Better details lead to faster help.
Requests.searchPlaceholder: What do you need? A book, slides, an exam…
Requests.formType: What kind of item do you need?
Requests.titlePlaceholder: Example: I need the Computer Networks textbook
Requests.descriptionPlaceholder: Mention the edition, instructor, course, or any detail that helps students understand your request…
Requests.requestHint: Do not post your phone number here; you can exchange contact details after receiving a reply.
Requests.communityNote: A clear request gets faster help
